card.name: Digits inside numbers in tables and counts
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle or end of a multi-digit number, such as table values, patient counts like (20<<4>>/285), or decimals. It is most common in dosimetry tables and adverse-reaction incidence figures.

modes.label: Table decimals
modes.description: A digit inside a decimal value in a table of organ dose figures or other numeric columns.

modes.label: Patient counts
modes.description: A digit inside the numerator or denominator of a count in parentheses after a percentage.
modes.example: Hypophysitis occurred in 0.6% (12/199<<4>>) of patients treated with single agent intr

modes.label: Schedule or volume numbers
modes.description: A digit within a day count or a volume in a dosing schedule or volume table.
modes.example: 1 drop three times a day for the next <<7>> days

card.plain: It fires on a digit within a longer number, as in a results table or a count of patients.
